title: Zephyr: Rule 1 compression
description: Implement Rule 1 compression in Zephyr C. Acceptance: compresses full IPv6/UDP headers, passes test vectors.
notes: Reconciled generic/full-header tracker wording against current Rule Set Version 3: Rule 1 is Yggdrasil 0200::/8 IPv6 + UDP + CoAP, with two 120-bit address suffixes and CoAP port MSB(12)/LSB(4). Replaced the stale C Rule 1 path with exact 286-bit/36-byte residue encoding (37-byte fixed header), zero padding, UDP checksum/nonzero validation, zero TC/flow, exact address/port context, CoAP version/TKL/token bounds, opaque token/options/payload tail, atomic output preflight, and 22554-byte ceiling. Added focused canonical, field/tail, nonmatch, checksum, short-buffer, and profile-bound tests. Validation: sanitizer-backed C PASS 1/1; Python Rule 1 PASS 23; Rust canonical/header PASS 2; Rules 2/3/4/7 C regressions PASS 7/7; cppcheck PASS.
close_reason: Implemented and cross-validated current-spec Zephyr SCHC Rule 1 compression
